rule: County is populated on every expenditure record
action: Kept and reported as "Unattributed"; never dropped

rule: County matches the official Texas county list
action: Resolved through ref_county_alias crosswalk; non-counties routed to Unattributed

rule: Amount is parseable after standard cleaning
Placeholder ("-" or "$ -") used instead of a number
Fiscal year on record matches the fiscal year in the file title
action: Records re-assigned to their own fiscal year (recovers FY2017)

rule: Spending category maps to an analysis group
action: Unmapped categories would be flagged; none found

rule: One record per county x category x fiscal year (expected grain)
action: Aggregated to expected grain; amounts summed
Kept: grain is not unique in source, so identical rows can be legitimate split payments
Kept: negative amounts are reversals/refunds and net against spending

rule: Every Texas county has DFPS spending recorded in the year
action: Reported; county shown with $0 attributed spending

rule: Service-data records map to a Texas county
action: Out of State / Unknown records excluded from county metrics, retained in statewide totals

rule: Child population is populated for every county-year
action: Per-capita rates set to NULL where population missing

rule: Yearly extracts share one column layout
action: Each layout mapped explicitly in sql/02_staging.sql

rule: A file published at one row per county contains each county once (FY2016)
action: Kept and summed; flagged for source confirmation - may be mis-keyed counties
